messages.en: Our school friends are getting together at the mamak stall tonight. Want to come along?
Yeah! I'll come straight after work. Save me a seat, okay?
This hand movement is a bit tricky. Have you memorized it yet?
Yeah. Just watch the video at a slower speed first.
I'm going to church this morning. Let's meet in the afternoon, okay?
Sure. Message me when you're done, okay?
Our little sister has a loose tooth, but it hasn't fallen out yet.
No wonder she kept looking at her teeth in the mirror earlier.
